title: Strict SSRF Ingestion Boundary Enforcement
description: Server-side web crawler validates and denies all private network blocks, loopback interfaces, cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), and non-standard schemes before dispatching HTTP fetch requests.
root_cause: Unvalidated crawler input could permit attackers to probe internal cloud environments or localhost services.
intended_behavior: The SSRF validator strictly resolves targets via safe DNS checks and drops non-routable, private, or metadata IPs.

title: Timing-Safe Webhook HMAC-SHA256 Signature Verification
description: Inbound webhooks for WhatsApp Cloud API and Stripe must be cryptographically verified using constant-time comparison to prevent message forgery and timing analysis.
root_cause: Direct string comparison (===) of cryptographic signatures leaks timing information enabling byte-by-byte forgery.
intended_behavior: Signatures are computed with HMAC-SHA256 and compared using crypto.timingSafeEqual on equal-length buffers.

title: Anti-Sybil Free Trial Abuse & Bulk Account Mitigation
description: Automated engine blocks disposable domain registrations, enforces real-time SMS/OTP identity proofs, and limits free trial grants to 1 per verified phone number and device.
root_cause: Unrestricted trial signups allow bot farms to exhaust AI quota without payment.
intended_behavior: Signup engine cross-checks phone numbers and email domains against disposable lists and active trial ledgers.
